divergences.description: Extend the upstream string-only filesystem bridge and VFS open modes to accept supported Linux numeric flags, and expose O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW constants. Numeric access modes 0, 1 and 2 select read, write and read/write; O_CREAT, O_TRUNC and O_APPEND control creation, truncation and append, while O_EXCL rejects existing files only with O_CREAT. Reject unsafe integers, negative values, unsupported bits and access mode 3 with ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE. O_NOFOLLOW is accepted without a link check because the VFS has no symbolic links; existing string modes are unchanged.
divergences.reason: Worker filesystem consumers pass numeric open flags; the upstream string-only implementation cannot interpret those requests. The supported subset must retain explicit rejection of unsupported values instead of silently selecting a string mode.
